correctness.rationale: All spectral eigenvalues and eigenvectors are explicitly reconstructed: 0, radial (n+1)g, and angular g+2-2cos(2pi k/n). Strict angular eigenvalue separation leaves one collision per positive resonant g. Spectral-projector interpolation proves Kalman rank equals summed two-vertex eigenspace evaluation ranks. Gcd counts identify every dependent angular observation pair; the combined radial/angular rank matrices give the sole exceptional cancellation. Standalone exact rational Krylov and independent numerical eigenspace calculations passed 3,286 comparisons. No finite computation substitutes for this all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: The new formula is a complete exact all-dimensional controllable-subspace classification on a natural wheel diffusion network with two independent ring actuators. It reveals isolated positive spoke-weight design hazards, arithmetic leader-placement obstructions and surprising cancellation of a spectral resonance for certain antipodal evaluation patterns. These directly affect weight selection and actuator placement and are not a trivial one-case PBH computation.
